test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ​What percentage of seats in the Lok Sabha is required to be won by a political party from at least three different states, to be eligible to be recognised as a national party?
solution:
The correct answer is **__2 percent.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to** the Election Commission of India**, a political party shall be eligible to be recognized as a** national party** only if it fulfils **any **one of the following three conditions:

 
 
• **It wins at least 2% (11 seats) in the Lok Sabha and these members are elected from at least three different states**.
 
• **And It secures at least 6% of the total valid votes polled in any four or more states at a general election to the Lok Sabha or to the State Legislative Assembly. In addition, ** it wins **at least 4 seats in Lok Sabha** from any State or states.
 
• **A party gets recognition as State Party in four or more States.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lok Sabha is also known as a** lower house or a temporary house**.
 
• The total strength of the Lok Sabha is **552 .**
 
• In January 2020 The seats reserved for Anglo Indians in Parliament and State Legislatures of India were discontinued by the **126th Constitutional Amendment Bill of 2019 **enacted as** 104th Constitutional Amendment Act 2019**.
 
• The tenure of Lok Sabha is 5 years and it can be dissolved by the President of India before the expiration of tenure.
 
• The first male speaker of Lok Sabha is **Ganesh Vasudeo Mavalankar and the first female speaker is Meira Kumar.**
 
• **At present, there are 543 Lok Sabha constituencies and this number has not changed since 1971**.
